The '''''Dewback''''' was a warship in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] that participated in the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]. [[Kral Nevil]], captain of the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] wanted to bring the ''Dewback'' in to aid the ''Anakin Solo''{{'s}} attack on [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]].
